name: G6 T3 W03 - Tables and story data
description: Optional review. No required vocabulary task this week. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: Facts or values that can be stored and used.
words.example: The data shows that twelve students chose chess.

words.definition: Information arranged in rows and columns.
words.example: The table puts each club name beside its student count.

words.definition: A line of cells going across a table.
words.example: Row 3 contains the club name and its student count.

words.definition: A line of cells going down a table.
words.example: Column B contains the student counts.

words.definition: A picture that presents data so people can compare or understand it.
words.example: The chart uses bars to compare the club counts.
